plan.summary: P9 S7b CRITICAL FAIL root cause investigation revealed P9 roadmap's 3 fix options (a/b/c) were based on a WRONG hypothesis. Actual root cause: orphan 'default' Hangfire queue. Two job registrations (ApiKeyRateLimiter.SweepNow in Backend/Program.cs and FollowupStageJob class in Marketing) lack explicit queue routing (no [Queue] attribute) → Hangfire defaults them to 'default' queue → 5 active servers (backend/automation/appointments/integrations/marketing-followup) all listen to their dedicated named queues, NONE listens to 'default' → jobs stuck forever in hangfire.jobqueue. Evidence: 1019 stuck ApiKeyRateLimiter.SweepNow rows on 'default' queue in prod since 2026-04-18 (4-day latent bug). P9 EFS drip failed same pattern: FollowupStageJob scheduled to 'default' queue, Marketing worker on 'marketing-followup' never picks it up. Fix: 3 code changes (attribute-based, canonical pattern matching existing named jobs) + 1 startup guard + prod orphan cleanup. Code surface: (1) src/Invekto.Marketing/Services/Jobs/FollowupStageJob.cs — class-level [Hangfire.Queue("marketing-followup")] attribute (single invocable method, class-level canonical); (2) src/Invekto.Backend/Services/ApiKeyRateLimiter.cs — method-level [Hangfire.Queue("backend")] on SweepNow() only (service class has non-Hangfire methods; method-level avoids spurious tagging); (3) src/Invekto.Backend/Program.cs — orphan queue startup WARN guard (emits [INV-JOB-006] log with drain SQL); (4) arch/errors.md — new INV-JOB-006 error code. Note: Initial draft considered RecurringJobOptions.Queue=4th-arg overload, but Hangfire 1.8.14's RecurringJobOptions class does not expose a Queue property (build CS0117). Switched to attribute-based routing which is the canonical pattern in this codebase (VideoMeetingCreationJob, RescueFollowUpJob, FlowWaitResumerJob, OrderSyncJob, ReminderJob, etc. all use [Queue] attributes; no caller passes Queue via options). Post-deploy: MCP DELETE 1019 orphan rows. Re-smoke P9 S7b+S8 verifies fix (stage[0] scheduled → Succeeded + event_followup_runs.status='sent' + [FEAT-EFS][SEND-INTENT] log).

verdict.raw_text: Iter 0 FAIL: CQ8 plan/code drift on RecurringJobOptions vs method-attribute + CQ12 missing INV code in WARN log. Iter 1 PASS 12/12 CQ + 3/3 CoVe, 0 blocker. Fix: plan/tracking synced to attribute-based canonical pattern; INV-JOB-006 added to errors.md; Program.cs WARN log prefix switched from [HANGFIRE][ORPHAN_QUEUE] to [INV-JOB-006].

CQ1.evidence: Typed Npgsql.NpgsqlException catch + [INV-JOB-006] WARN log in both paths.

CQ2.evidence: No silent failure — success path warns when orphan > 0, catch warns on probe fail; non-blocking by design.

CQ3.evidence: All diff files in allowed_files + files_changed; no scope creep.

CQ4.evidence: Attribute-based routing is canonical pattern (FollowupStageJob/VideoMeetingCreationJob/RescueFollowUpJob); no duplicate helpers.

CQ5.evidence: Hangfire.* FQN attributes match existing [Hangfire.AutomaticRetry(...)] style; Program.cs guard mirrors existing score=-1 nudge probe pattern.

CQ6.evidence: Single SELECT COUNT startup probe, using-var disposal, no N+1.

CQ8.evidence: Additive attributes only; method signatures + 3-arg AddOrUpdate unchanged; no DTO/interface contract change.

Q1.reasoning: Class-level [Queue] attribute on FollowupStageJob applies to both BackgroundJob.Schedule<T> + future RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate<T> type-based registrations.

Q2.reasoning: Probe runs after EnsureJobStorageInitialized + score=-1 nudge (same block, same timing guarantees); Npgsql typed catch degrades gracefully to non-fatal WARN.

Q3.reasoning: Method-level [Queue] on ApiKeyRateLimiter.SweepNow avoids spurious class-level tagging of TryAcquire/Sweep(DateTime); Hangfire.QueueAttribute supports AttributeTargets.Class|Method; build PASS confirms API-legal.
